Coverage_Description: Private motor insurance with Third Party Only or Comprehensive options; includes third-party liability and benefits such as NCD protection (claim <= HK$60,000 or 15% of limit, whichever lower), zero-depreciation replacement for brand-new cars (<1 year)
customer requirement: Applicant must be 18+; provide vehicle registration and driving licence copies
price structure: Premium is underwriting-based; comprehensive premium uses declared Limit of Indemnity
additional informations: Claims recovery service may refund paid excess and reinstate NCD if third-party recovery succeeds; 24-hour claims advisory hotline; special features apply to Private Comprehensive Insurance only
